cachePolicy: Probe only the listed SHAs in existing local Git stores; reuse available complete closures without reading other refs/content. One isolated acquisition cache. No ambient credential helpers or Git URL rewriting. Existing proxy environment retained without value logging; no TLS weakening or alternate route. Stop on first denial/failure.
exportPolicy: Reuse existing exportEvaluationCheckout / inspectEvaluationCheckout; per-PR before and after export each allows ONLY its checkout SHA ancestor closure (not other selected PR heads). Reuse evaluation binding and pure mining input builder; no backend/model invocation.
executionPolicy: Only Git object/checkout/hash inspection and application static checks; no upstream code/hooks/submodule or dependency execution. Source cache not supplied as a workspace.
budgetEnforcement: Deadline and disk monitoring terminate the stage on breach; per-file subprocess resource cap complements existing export pack/object limits. Record enforcement limits honestly (no filesystem quota available). All temporary acquisition/export artifacts counted; failure artifacts retained; successful derived checkouts cleaned and immutable export availability recorded.
history: Exact allowed object closure excludes unrelated/future refs; historical public visibility remains unproven, commit timestamps not proof.
publication: Plan must be pushed before first upstream Git read. Code and evidence via own GitHub feature branch/draft PR stacked on #18. No main merge.
